messages:
deploy-bot: rolling out api v2 -> 20% of traffic (NA/EU) starting now. maintenance window 2026-06-01T22:00Z. release-id=rl-2026-06-v2-01 :rocket:
emma: quick note — this rollout flips on the header-gate `X-API-Version: 2` + a small shim for missing headers. default behavior will be v1 for missing header unless shim enabled.
sanjay: what are the rollback triggers? need clear numbers for oncall runbook.
marta: docs + release notes: I'll draft a migration note and call out the header and the shim. tagging docs-bot to link the changelog.
ops-oncall: set pager if 5xx > 2% sustained for 5m OR p95 latency increases > 400ms for 10m. also watch deploybot health events.
emma: added the proposed criteria to the runbook: `rollback-if: (5xx_rate >= 0.02 && duration>=300s) || (p95_lat>400ms && duration>=600s)`
sanjay: on the shim — we can enable `compat.allow_missing_version=true` for the rollout window. That maps requests without header to v1 behavior but still routes v1->v2-compatible proxies. It's cheap and reversible.
emma: thumbs-up. but we should log a new metric `shim_mapped_to_v1` to track traffic. want to keep an eye on mobile clients that haven't migrated.
marta: docs-bot: please add an item to the release notes: "v2 rollout: header-gate X-API-Version, optional shim for missing header, rollback criteria, contact list"
docs-bot: created draft https://confluence.redwood.example/rl-2026-06-v2-01 (internal).
ops-oncall: can we get a quick curl sample for clients to validate header? I'll paste in the incident runbook.
emma: sure —
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-API-Version: 2" -d '{"input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.example/v2/generate
```
If header omitted the shim maps to v1 path: `GET /v1/fallback` behavior.
sanjay: small risk: some edge proxies (old mobile SDKs) send `x-api-version` lowercase; our header matching is case-insensitive in the gateway, but double-checking.
emma: confirmed — gateway normalizes header case. added telemetry `header_case_fallback` just in case.
marta: question on release notes wording: do we emphasize "no breaking behavior for clients without header"? I prefer "clients without header remain on v1; enable upgrade path via X-API-Version" so we don't promise shim forever.
sanjay: agreed. also add: "compat shim is temporary and may be disabled after 2 weeks once telemetry shows <1% missing headers".
ops-oncall: reminder: if the shim causes issues (weird 4xx spike), we should flip it off ASAP and pin high-traffic tenants to v1 via deploybot pin list. How do we pin?
emma: deploybot supports tenant pinning: `deploybot pin tenant=TENANT_ID version=v1 reason="compat-shim"` — ops can run that.
ops-oncall: copy. please make a quick checklist for oncall: how to run pin and how to flip shim.
marta: I'll add the checklist to the runbook page. itemizing: (1) check metrics dashboard, (2) run `deploybot pin ...` if needed, (3) flip `compat.allow_missing_version=false` in config, (4) notify customers + slack channel.
sanjay: telemetry to monitor: `5xx_rate`, `p95_lat`, `shim_mapped_to_v1`, `header_missing_pct`, `client_version_distribution`. I'll add dashboards.
ops-oncall: set an alert for `header_missing_pct > 5%` for >1h so we can follow up with product outreach.
emma: small nit: what about function/tool-calling behavior differences between v1/v2? we should list endpoints that changed contract so we can watch for regression alerts.
marta: can we generate a short table in the release notes listing the endpoints with contract changes? I can get that from the API spec.
emma: good. also include a note for SDK authors: sample code to set header automatically.
sanjay: one more operational safety: enable gradual ramp: 20% -> 50% in 30m steps, pause between each step for 5m for telemetry check. deploybot has `ramp_policy=staged(20,50,30m,5m)` option.
deploy-bot: acknowledged. applying ramp_policy staged(20,50,30m,5m). next step scheduled in 30m.
ops-oncall: thanks — I'll be on watch for the next hour. ping me @ops-oncall if anything spikes. :eyes:
marta: publishing release note draft now, will update after first pause. tagging @sanjay and @emma for final wording review.
emma: reading now. small wording tweak: change "temporary shim" -> "compat shim (short-lived)" for clarity.
sanjay: added dashboard links and query snippets to the runbook.
ops-oncall: if we need to rollback fully, plan is: (1) run full rollback via deploybot `rollback rl-2026-06-v2-01`, (2) pin top 50 tenants to v1, (3) notify CSMs. Confirm?
emma: confirm. add step 0: set `maintenance_mode=true` for API to reduce client confusion during rollback notification window.
marta: done — release note updated with rollback steps and contact matrix.
deploy-bot: ramp to 35% completed. next pause in 5m. metrics: 5xx_rate=0.0012, p95=220ms, header_missing_pct=4.7%, shim_mapped_to_v1=3.8%.
ops-oncall: looks good. continuing watch. :thumbsup:
marta: posting an outreach note for customer success for any tenants with header_missing_pct > 10%.
sanjay: flagging one tenant with old SDK we saw in telemetry — tenant=acme-corp at 9.8% missing header. ops, if that goes >10% we will pin them.
ops-oncall: noted. will pin if crosses threshold.
emma: leaving a short postmortem checklist in the page so product can follow up after 2 weeks.
marta: thanks team — will mark this rollout as "monitoring" until we hit the 2-week safe window. :white_check_mark:
